description: Fictional-only Phase 5 answer-quality evaluation. Controlled provider payloads are test outputs, not live-model results. Source locators were checked against fictional_documents.json.

layers.A: Answer-service component evaluation supplies source-verified evidence directly and uses controlled provider responses.
layers.B: Offline end-to-end evaluation uses the actual eligible fictional fixture and frozen retriever; provider output is mocked and no ideal evidence is injected.
layers.C: Live-model evaluation plan only. No live or paid request was made. A human reviewer must score the rubric before any live acceptance claim.

cases.question: When does Term A enrollment open?
forbidden_claims: This is an actual university policy.
answer_texts: Term A enrollment opens January 4, 2027.

forbidden_claims: Classes start on the enrollment deadline.
answer_texts: Term A enrollment closes January 8, 2027.

forbidden_claims: Fixed charges are included in the rate.
answer_texts: Term A tuition is ₱1,000 per unit.

forbidden_claims: Office hours substituted for installment schedule.
answer_texts: The optional simulated plan lets learners pay tuition in three installments: 40% January 22, 30% February 19, and 30% March 19.

cases.question: What fee follows a missed installment after the grace period?
required_claims: One-time ₱250 fee after five calendar days.
answer_texts: A one-time ₱250 fee applies per missed installment after the five-calendar-day grace period; it does not compound.

cases.question: How much tuition is refunded for withdrawal through February 12?

answer_texts: Withdrawal January 16–February 12 refunds 50% of paid tuition; after February 12, no tuition refund.

cases.question: What GPA and unit load does Lakbay require?
answer_texts: Lakbay GPA must not exceed 1.75; carry at least 15 units and have no failed courses.

cases.question: Does meeting Lakbay eligibility guarantee an award?
